_comment: DELIVERY-GATE-1 fix manifest, read by scripts/check-delivery.py.
EVERY FIELD HERE IS A CLAIM THAT THE CHECKER VERIFIES AGAINST A PRIMARY
SOURCE. Nothing in this file is trusted. A commit that does not exist, a
gate that is not in RendererFeatureRegistry.h, an `expect_default` that
disagrees with the C++ reader, a `needle` that is absent from the named
path at the named commit -- each of those is an INTEGRITY FAILURE (exit 2),
not a skipped entry. That is the whole point: this manifest is the kind of
artifact that historically became the lie, so it is the artifact under the
most suspicion.
FIELDS
id             stable name, used as --fix argument
commit         the commit that INTRODUCED the code (git log -S on the reader)
gate           MC2_* env var, or null for an ungated change
expect_default 'ON' | 'OFF' | a decimal string for numeric gates | null
exe_needle     a literal the fix puts in the IMAGE (uniform name, gate
name). Strongest evidence tier: it is read out of the
binary's own bytes, so a revert, a failed compile or a
stale copy cannot fake it.
code_evidence  [{path, needle}] checked against `git show <embedded>:<path>`
for each install -- catches WITHDRAWN code, which ancestry
alone cannot (a revert leaves the introducing commit an
ancestor forever).
data           [{kind, path|glob, needle?, min_count?}] the deploy-tree
files the fix needs. kind=file with a needle is the
half-data shape: the file is there but predates the fix, so
glGetUniformLocation returns -1 and the gate runs OFF while
reporting ON.

fixes.note: VEHICLE-NIGHT-LIT-1. Introduced default-OFF, promoted to default-ON by VEHICLE-LIGHTING-PATH-1. The per-install default column is therefore expected to DIFFER between installs, which is exactly the thing this tool exists to show.

The half-data fix named in its own commit message: 'the deployed shaders/ tree must carry the new gos_tex_vertex_lighted.vert or the uniform does not exist in the program, glGetUniformLocation returns -1, the set silently no-ops and the gate runs OFF while reporting ON.'

A RETRACTION, not a feature: CONCRETE-DELIVER-2 reverts a default-ON that the promoting lane's own status doc had already retracted in writing. A numeric gate, so check-gate-default-agreement.py skips it as 'value-read (not a boolean gate)' -- nothing else in the tree compares its per-install default against the tip. Grading concrete on an install that predates this commit grades WITHDRAWN code.

Default-ON and degrades to a silent no-op when the .beauty sidecar is absent (check-beauty-sidecars.py module docstring). scripts/deploy_payload.py deliberately never walks data/missions/*.beauty/, so the sidecar reaches a tree only by a manual copy.
